"""Hand-computed expectations for semantic corner cases."""
import json
import subprocess
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/tmp/dev")
import ref
import validate_out

    payload = b"".join((json.dumps(r) + "\n").encode() for r in reqs)
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=payload, capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()[:2000]
    return [json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.decode().splitlines()]

        {"op": "endswith", "path": ["a", "b"]}, {"op": "contains", "path": ["a", "b"]}]}], "queries": [[], ["a", "b"], ["a", "b", "a", "b"]]},

outs = run([c[1] for c in cases])
bad = 0
for (name, req, exp), out in zip(cases, outs):
    want = ref.ref_compile(req)
    if out != want:
        print("REF MISMATCH", name, json.dumps(out), json.dumps(want)); bad += 1
    d = out["dfa"]
    got = (d["accept"], d["next"], d["distance"])
    if got != exp:
        print("EXPECTED MISMATCH %-28s\n   got    %s\n   expect %s" % (name, json.dumps(got), json.dumps(exp))); bad += 1
    validate_out.validate(out, req, exhaustive_len=7 if len(req["services"]) <= 2 else None, sample=10)
    sidx = {s: i for i, s in enumerate(req["services"])}
    for path, res in zip(req["queries"], out["queries"]):
        s = 0
        for tok in path:
            s = d["next"][s][sidx[tok]]
        assert res == {"state": s, "allow": d["accept"][s], "distance": d["distance"][s]}, (name, res)
